roadmap.driver_story: US-27 — SHA256 hash persistence across launches
roadmap.notes: DISCUSS/DESIGN/DISTILL already complete in parent feature workspace. This roadmap covers DELIVER only. 3 acceptance scenarios are @skip; DELIVER un-skips them one at a time as each slice goes green. Migration 0002 is purely additive (adds cache_sha256 table). cache_models.sha256 (Tier 2) already shipped in Release 2; this adds Tier 3 (file-level cache_sha256) + opt-in flag + cache verify CLI.

phases.name: Walking skeleton — SHA256 persists across launches when file unchanged (AC-27-1/2/7)

steps.name: Migration 0002 + cache_sha256 table + schema-version bump
criteria: RED: modeltap-store test asserts cache_sha256 table exists after Cache::open on a fresh DB (PRAGMA user_version = 2).
RED: forward-migration test — a v1 DB (user_version=1, populated cache_models) migrates to v2 with zero data loss in cache_models/cache_tools.

GREEN: crates/modeltap-store/migrations/0002_add_sha256_persistence.sql creates cache_sha256(path PK, mtime_epoch_ns, size_bytes, inode, dev, content_hash TEXT, computed_at TEXT) + index on (inode, dev).
GREEN: migrate.rs EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2 and migrations() registers M::up(0002).
cargo fmt -p modeltap-store && clippy -p modeltap-store -- -D warnings && test -p modeltap-store green.
Step-ID: 01-01 trailer.
steps.implementation_notes: DDL per ADR-018 §Release 3: path is PK; store (mtime,size,inode,dev) validity quad + content_hash (lowercase hex TEXT) + computed_at (ISO-8601 UTC). rusqlite_migration bumps user_version to 2 automatically. Additive only — no ALTER on existing tables.

steps.name: CachedSha256 type + Sha256Repo CRUD (get_by_path, upsert, validity-quad)
criteria: RED: store unit test round-trips a CachedSha256 row (upsert then get_by_path returns equal value, hex lowercase preserved).
RED: get_by_path on unknown path returns None.
GREEN: CachedSha256 type in types.rs; repo/sha256.rs with upsert_sha256, get_sha256_by_path, invalidate_sha256(path), all_sha256 (for verify).
GREEN: FileStat-quad reuse — CachedSha256 carries a FileStat for matches() comparison.
cargo fmt/clippy/test -p modeltap-store green.
steps.implementation_notes: Mirror repo/models.rs structure (RawRow + hydrate + with_conn_mut transaction). Reuse types::FileStat for the quad. content_hash stored as ContentHash hex (lowercase) per tech-stack memory.

steps.name: [cache] persist_sha256 opt-in flag (default false)
criteria: RED: config test — default persist_sha256 is false; explicit `persist_sha256 = true` parses; absent key keeps default.
GREEN: CacheConfig.persist_sha256: bool added to config.rs + CacheSection; default false.
Existing config tests stay green (opt-out semantics for `enabled` unchanged).
cargo fmt/clippy/test -p modeltap-app green.
steps.implementation_notes: Default false per ADR-018 (flip to true in a later release after dogfooding). Add #[serde(default)] persist_sha256: Option<bool> to CacheSection.

steps.name: Warm-start Tier-3 seed + hash-pool Tier-3 writeback + un-skip AC-27-1
criteria: RED: acceptance scenario 'SHA256 hash persists across launches when the file is unchanged' un-skipped and drives the modeltap binary across two launches; second launch shows dedup key with NO hash.computed event in launch.log for the unchanged file.
GREEN: when persist_sha256=true, warm-start loads cache_sha256 rows whose validity quad matches current stat into the in-process Sha256Cache (Tier 3 -> Tier 1 seed).
GREEN: on Msg::HashComputed, writeback to cache_sha256 (best-effort, spawn_blocking) in addition to existing Tier-2 cache_models.sha256.
GREEN: provenance line reads 'dedup key computed <N> days ago' from computed_at.
cargo fmt/clippy green; AC-27-1 scenario + parent regression green.
steps.implementation_notes: Tier-3 read must verify the (mtime,size,inode,dev) quad against a fresh stat before seeding Tier-1 (stale rows are skipped, not seeded). Writeback is best-effort (R10): a write failure MUST NOT block the action. sha256_cache.rs stays in-process; persistence lives in the store; wiring bridges them.

steps.name: Quad-drift invalidation + re-queue + (computing...) + un-skip scenario 2
criteria: RED: acceptance scenario 'SHA256 hash invalidates when (mtime,size,inode,dev) differs' un-skipped; mtime drift invalidates the cached hash, queues a fresh computation via the pool, and the dedup key shows '(computing...)' until done.
GREEN: at SHA256 lookup, a Tier-3 row whose quad mismatches the fresh stat is invalidated (row deleted/NULLed) and a HashJob is enqueued.
GREEN: @property invariant — for any quad mismatch the cached value is never seeded into Tier 1 (proptest or table-driven).
cargo fmt/clippy green; scenario 2 + parent regression green.
steps.implementation_notes: Reuse FileStat::matches for the quad check. '(computing...)' reuses the existing HashProgress render path. Invalidation must be idempotent.

steps.name: cache verify CLI: rehash all, report drift, update cache, diagnostics.log + un-skip scenario 3
criteria: RED: acceptance scenario 'modeltap cache verify rehashes everything and reports drift' un-skipped; 2 silently-replaced files (same mtime/size, different content) are detected, listed in stdout, cache updated, and diagnostics.log records 'cache_verify drift_count=2'.
GREEN: clap subcommand `modeltap cache verify` in main.rs dispatching to a verify routine in modeltap-store (verify.rs) that recomputes every cache_sha256 row's hash and compares.
GREEN: drift entries printed to stdout; cache_sha256 updated with recomputed values; ~/.modeltap/diagnostics.log appended with drift_count.
GREEN: `modeltap cache` family is non-TUI (headless exit), does not launch the event loop.
cargo fmt/clippy green; scenario 3 + parent regression green.
steps.implementation_notes: Verify recomputes content_hash (not just the quad) — this is the deliberate full rehash that catches same-mtime/size content swaps. Use the existing Sha2Hasher. diagnostics.log path = ~/.modeltap/diagnostics.log (respect HOME override seam used by other tests).
